entry.summary:
Ahead of the All Blacks hosting Italy in Wellington on Saturday afternoon in the second round of the Nations Championship, captain Ardie Savea was joined by his whānau at the team's captain's run | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

During questions from reporters, Savea's daughter had a question of her own – asking what his favourite part about being All Blacks captain is.

Read more: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/sport/697147/family-time-keeps-all-blacks-captain-ardie-savea-fresh
